item.title: South Korea’s Dark Past: How It Explains Korea’s Current Political Crisis
item.description: Historically speaking, South Korea has not always been the vibrant democratic country that many worldwide perceive it to be today. Since gaining independence in 1948, South Korea was under the rule of three authoritarian governments until 1988. The first government, led by Korean independence activist Syngman Rhee, ruled from 1948 to 1960 with an iron first over the nation.
